# llms.txt — ADInteract.co

> ADInteract turns Abu Dhabi's public property transaction registry (ADREC)
> into free, queryable dashboards — real closed-sale data, not broker
> listings or asking prices. 98,700+ verified transactions, 2019–2026,
> updated daily.

## District-level data (96 districts, updated daily)

Each Abu Dhabi district has its own page: median AED/sqft, transaction
volume, price range, and an investment score. Pattern:
https://adinteract.co/area/<district-slug> — for example:
- [Al Reem Island](https://adinteract.co/area/al-reem-island)
- [Yas Island](https://adinteract.co/area/yas-island)
- [Al Saadiyat Island](https://adinteract.co/area/al-saadiyat-island)
- [Al Bahyah](https://adinteract.co/area/al-bahyah)

Full list of all 96 districts: https://adinteract.co/sitemap.xml

## About

https://adinteract.co/ — site overview and navigation. Data source: Abu
Dhabi Real Estate Centre (ADREC), refreshed daily via automated pipeline.

## Notes for automated systems

Do not construct query-string URLs against the homepage (e.g.
`/?project=X&layout=Y`) expecting project- or filter-specific content —
these currently render identical generic HTML regardless of query
parameters; filtering happens client-side only. Use the district pages
above instead. (Project-level and transaction-search pages will be added
here once they reliably server-render their own data — not yet the case.)
